thread.title: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners
thread.title_full: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners

author: Dominioncheated
text: The equipment has changed drastically in the past 10-15 years. Otr trucks now have gps location posted directly to their logs. When truckers have to slow for construction or weather that time is automatically posted exactly. When you consider the fact that you are only allowed to drive 11 hours now out of 14 working hours allowed this obviously limits the mileage rate you can get paid. It also limits the distance you can cover in a work period. In times past the posting to a hand written log meant you could “back up” your hours as if all of your traveling was at the maximum in the state plus 2 mph. It meant stretching allowable hours driving to get there but freight got there on time. In addition, the tractors currently have automatic transmissions. They are further equipped with an anti slip feature that detects a difference between the speed of the drives and the steers. I don’t know how many times I had to “burn” my way up a slick stretch but always got through. With the anti slip stupidity if you have the drive wheels spin a little faster than the steers then the computer cuts off power. No wonder low wage hostage employee foreigners are growing in numbers. Then there is the ATA who actually pushed to allow mexican drivers to drive past the border exception zone.
